# Thinking Raven brand

> Official brand kit and design system for Thinking Raven (thinkingraven.com): logos, colours, typography, tokens, reference components, exports and usage rules. Published at https://thinkingraven.github.io/brand/ (source: github.com/thinkingraven/brand). AI agents should follow AGENTS.md for branded output and DESIGN.md for any UI. Never redraw or retype the logo.

Key facts: the name in prose is "Thinking Raven". The logo is the lowercase wordmark "thinking raven." (two words with a fixed clear space, "raven" bold) with an amber full stop. Colours: bone canvas #F3EFE6, raven ink #0F0F14, thought amber #F2A93B (accent only; never text on light backgrounds; one primary action per view). Fonts: Space Grotesk (UI and display) and Space Mono (code and kickers). Mascot: Thinky. Contact: hello@thinkingraven.com.

## Rules
- [AGENTS.md](https://thinkingraven.github.io/brand/AGENTS.md): instructions for agents (which file to use where, rules, voice, snippets, checklist)
- [DESIGN.md](https://thinkingraven.github.io/brand/DESIGN.md): the design system (YAML tokens plus guide: colours, type scale, layout, elevation, components, motion, accessibility, responsive)
- [Brand guidelines site](https://thinkingraven.github.io/brand/): the human-readable guide with live components

## Tokens and CSS
- [tokens.json](https://thinkingraven.github.io/brand/tokens/tokens.json): W3C design tokens
- [tokens.css](https://thinkingraven.github.io/brand/tokens/tokens.css): CSS variables, fonts and dark mode
- [components.css](https://thinkingraven.github.io/brand/css/components.css): reference components (tr- classes)

- [Logo morph, ink](https://thinkingraven.github.io/brand/logos/final/thinkingraven-logo-morph-ink.svg): the wordmark that collapses to the monogram in website navigation; inline it and use `.tr-logo-morph` from components.css
